arguments.purpose: Compare Women's Jeans and Dresses net revenue between August 2026 and September 2026
arguments.sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', oi.created_at) AS month,
    SUM(oi.sale_price) AS net_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
  WHERE p.department = 'Women'
    AND p.category IN ('Jeans', 'Dresses')
    AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND oi.created_at >= '2026-08-01'
    AND oi.created_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS aug_2026_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS sep_2026_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS diff_amount,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM monthly_revenue
GROUP BY category

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Total' AS category,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS aug_2026_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS sep_2026_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS diff_amount,

FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY category

arguments.purpose: Analyze dress sales by price bands across holiday seasons and LTM
arguments.sql:
WITH item_bands AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.id,
    oi.sale_price,
    oi.created_at,
    CASE 
      WHEN oi.sale_price < 50 THEN '1. Under $50'
      WHEN oi.sale_price >= 50 AND oi.sale_price < 100 THEN '2. $50 - $99.99'
      WHEN oi.sale_price >= 100 AND oi.sale_price < 150 THEN '3. $100 - $149.99'
      WHEN oi.sale_price >= 150 AND oi.sale_price < 200 THEN '4. $150 - $199.99'
      ELSE '5. $200+'
    END AS price_band,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM oi.created_at) IN (11, 12) THEN 'Holiday (Nov-Dec)'
      ELSE 'Non-Holiday'
    END AS season,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) AS order_year

arguments.purpose: Analyze average order-to-shipment duration for Memphis and Chicago in September 2026
arguments.sql:
SELECT
  dc.name AS distribution_center,
  -- Shipped in September 2026
  COUNT(CASE WHEN oi.shipped_at >= '2026-09-01' AND oi.shipped_at < '2026-10-01' THEN oi.id END) AS items_shipped_in_sep,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN oi.shipped_at >= '2026-09-01' AND oi.shipped_at < '2026-10-01' 
            THEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.shipped_at, oi.created_at, SECOND) / 3600.0 END), 2) AS avg_hours_shipped_sep,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN oi.shipped_at >= '2026-09-01' AND oi.shipped_at < '2026-10-01' 
            THEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.shipped_at, oi.created_at, SECOND) / 86400.0 END), 2) AS avg_days_shipped_sep,
  -- Ordered in September 2026 (and shipped)
  COUNT(CASE WHEN oi.created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND oi.created_at < '2026-10-01' AND oi.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND oi.shipped_at <= '2026-10-01' THEN oi.id END) AS items_ordered_in_sep,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN oi.created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND oi.created_at < '2026-10-01' AND oi.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND oi.shipped_at <= '2026-10-01'
            THEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.shipped_at, oi.created_at, SECOND) / 3600.0 END), 2) AS avg_hours_ordered_sep,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN oi.created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND oi.created_at < '2026-10-01' AND oi.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND oi.shipped_at <= '2026-10-01'
            THEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.shipped_at, oi.created_at, SECOND) / 86400.0 END), 2) AS avg_days_ordered_sep
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.inventory_items` ii
  ON oi.inventory_item_id = ii.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers` dc
  ON ii.product_distribution_center_id = dc.id
WHERE dc.id IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY dc.name

arguments.purpose: Comprehensive order-to-shipment metrics for Memphis and Chicago in September 2026
arguments.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    dc.id AS dc_id,
    dc.name AS dc_name,
    oi.id AS order_item_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.created_at AS order_created_at,
    oi.created_at AS item_created_at,
    oi.shipped_at AS item_shipped_at,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.shipped_at, o.created_at, SECOND) / 3600.0 AS hours_from_order_created,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.shipped_at, oi.created_at, SECOND) / 3600.0 AS hours_from_item_created
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.inventory_items` ii ON oi.inventory_item_id = ii.id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers` dc ON ii.product_distribution_center_id = dc.id
  WHERE dc.id IN (1, 2)
)
SELECT
  'Shipped in Sep 2026' AS cohort,
  dc_name,
  COUNT(*) AS item_count,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_order_created), 2) AS avg_hours_from_order,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_order_created) / 24.0, 2) AS avg_days_from_order,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_item_created), 2) AS avg_hours_from_item,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_item_created) / 24.0, 2) AS avg_days_from_item
FROM base
WHERE item_shipped_at >= '2026-09-01' AND item_shipped_at < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY dc_name

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Shipped in Sep 2026 (Total)' AS cohort,
  'Combined (Memphis & Chicago)' AS dc_name,
  COUNT(*) AS item_count,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_order_created), 2) AS avg_hours_from_order,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_order_created) / 24.0, 2) AS avg_days_from_order,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_item_created), 2) AS avg_hours_from_item,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_item_created) / 24.0, 2) AS avg_days_from_item
FROM base
WHERE item_shipped_at >= '2026-09-01' AND item_shipped_at < '2026-10-01'

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Ordered in Sep 2026 (o.created_at)' AS cohort,

  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_order_created), 2) AS avg_hours_from_order,

  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_item_created), 2) AS avg_hours_from_item,

FROM base
WHERE order_created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND order_created_at < '2026-10-01'
  AND item_shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND item_shipped_at <= '2026-10-01'

SELECT

  'Combined (Memphis & Chicago)' AS dc_name,
  COUNT(*) AS item_count,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_order_created), 2) AS avg_hours_from_order,

  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_item_created), 2) AS avg_hours_from_item,
  ROUND(AVG(hours_from_item_created) / 24.0, 2) AS avg_days_from_item

arguments.purpose: Get weekly trend of orders, net revenue, and new users for Brazil and Spain for the last 6 completed weeks
arguments.sql:
WITH weekly_orders AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(oi.created_at), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
    CASE
      WHEN u.country = 'Brasil' THEN 'Brazil'
      WHEN u.country IN ('Spain', 'España') THEN 'Spain'
    END AS market,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
    COUNT(oi.id) AS items_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS gross_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN users u ON oi.user_id = u.id
  WHERE u.country IN ('Brasil', 'Spain', 'España')
    AND oi.created_at >= '2026-08-24' AND oi.created_at < '2026-10-05'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
weekly_users AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
    CASE
      WHEN country = 'Brasil' THEN 'Brazil'
      WHEN country IN ('Spain', 'España') THEN 'Spain'
    END AS market,
    COUNT(*) AS new_users
  FROM users
  WHERE country IN ('Brasil', 'Spain', 'España')
    AND created_at >= '2026-08-24' AND created_at < '2026-10-05'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  o.week_start,
  CONCAT(FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', o.week_start), ' to ', FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', DATE_ADD(o.week_start, INTERVAL 6 DAY))) AS week_range,
  o.market,
  u.new_users,
  o.orders,
  o.items_sold,
  o.gross_revenue,
  o.net_revenue,
  ROUND(o.net_revenue / NULLIF(o.orders, 0), 2) AS net_aov
FROM weekly_orders o
JOIN weekly_users u ON o.week_start = u.week_start AND o.market = u.market
ORDER BY o.week_start ASC, o.market ASC

        AND o2.created_at <= '2026-10-06 23:59:59'

      SELECT 1 FROM orders o2
      WHERE o2.user_id = ufo.user_id
        AND o2.created_at > ufo.first_order_all
        AND o2.created_at <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(ufo.first_order_all, INTERVAL 60 DAY)
        AND o2.created_at <= '2026-10-06 23:59:59'
    ) THEN ufo.user_id END) AS repeat_60d,

        AND o2.created_at <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(ufo.first_order_all, INTERVAL 90 DAY)
